items.notes: Dies-trigger filter is now self-inclusive: {CardTypes:[creature],IsToken:false,Controller:You} with NO ExcludeSelf. New disjunction guard (isDisjunction = lower.Contains('or another nontoken creature')) exactly mirrors the plain-creature Guard 2 (Zulaport). Sibling check PASSES: Bane, Lord of Darkness ('another nontoken creature', no 'or another') -> isDisjunction=false -> gold correctly retains ExcludeSelf:true. Anax and Bane are the only two nontoken-dies fixtures in the corpus; guard flips neither incorrectly.

AttachedModifyPTAndEveryCreatureTypeRule now cites CR 702.73a (Changeling CDA: 'This object is every creature type') verbatim; the stray 'CR 702.6 Changeling' is gone. Confirmed against rules-structure.json: 702.6 = Equip (old cite was wrong), 702.73a = Changeling. No residual 702.6 for Changeling in the file.

AsLongAsControlColorCreatureSelfKeywordGrantRule citation changed 611.2 -> 611.3a. Confirmed: 611.2 = continuous effect generated by RESOLUTION of a spell/ability (wrong for a static-ability grant); 611.3 = continuous effect generated by the STATIC ABILITY of an object; 611.3a = 'isn't locked in; it applies at any given moment...'. Correct for a static-ability conditional grant. No residual non-.3 611.2 in file. (Also cites 702.79a Persist, verified = Persist.)

Both ObjectHasCardTypeCondition.cs and AsLongAsEnchantedTypeKeywordGrantRule.cs replaced the fabricated 'CR 611.2c (verbatim)' quote with the real CR 611.3a text: 'A continuous effect generated by a static ability isn't locked in; it applies at any given moment to whatever its text indicates.' This is byte-for-byte the rules-structure.json 611.3a text. grep confirms NO residual 611.2c in either file.

_reservedNonSubtypeWords expanded to a closed 36-word vocab (colors/supertypes/co-card-types/permanent-states/structural) incl. 'Equipped'. (a) 'Equipped' now in the decline set -> TryParse returns null -> Dalakos no longer fabricates Subtypes:['Equipped']. (b) CRITICAL SWEEP: intersected all 36 declined words against the 317 real creature subtypes in type-ontology.json creature subtypePool -> ZERO collisions; no legitimate creature subtype is accidentally declined. (c) 'Sliver' is NOT in the decline set and IS a real subtype -> Cloudshredder still parses to Subtypes:['Sliver']. Case-sensitive (Ordinal) compare matches the regex's [A-Z][a-z]+ Titlecase capture.
